description_en: Lists the knowledge bases that the current caller can view in the specified region, with pagination
description_zh: 分页查询当前调用者在指定地域有权查看的知识库
name: ListKnowledgeBases

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of knowledge bases to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多返回的知识库数量，取值 1～100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. Do not specify this parameter when you request the first page. For subsequent pages, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response as is. An empty response indicates that no more pages are available. If the current page is empty but the cursor is not empty, continue pagination. Keep the same MaxResults value during pagination
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标。请求第一页时不传；后续页原样使用上次响应的 NextToken。响应为空表示没有下一页；即使当前页为空，游标非空仍应继续。翻页时保持相同 MaxResults
parameters.name: next_token

schema.description_en: The successful response of the API operation

Code.description_en: The business error code. This field may be omitted if the request succeeds. If the request fails, the common error response protocol applies
Code.description_zh: 业务错误代码。成功时可省略；失败遵循公共错误响应协议

Data.description_en: The list of knowledge bases on the current page and the cursor for the next page
Data.description_zh: 本页知识库列表及下一页游标

KnowledgeBases.description_en: The list of knowledge bases that the current caller has permission to view in the current region
KnowledgeBases.description_zh: 当前调用者在本地域有权查看的知识库列表

AccessRole.description_en:
The read-only access role of the current caller for the knowledge base. Valid values:
OWNER: owner
ADMIN: administrator
VIEWER: viewer
AccessRole.description_zh: 当前调用者对知识库的只读访问角色：OWNER 为负责人，ADMIN 为管理员，VIEWER 为查看者

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the knowledge base. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 知识库创建时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Description.description_en: The description of the knowledge base. This field can be empty if no description is set
Description.description_zh: 知识库的描述信息，未设置时可以为空
Description.example: 销售指标、订单及业务制度知识。

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The stable ID of the knowledge base, which can be used to limit the search scope
KnowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 知识库的稳定 ID，可用于限定检索范围

ModifyTime.description_en: The last modification time of the knowledge base. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ModifyTime.description_zh: 知识库最近修改时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Name.description_en: The name of the knowledge base

Owner.description_en: The DataWorks user ID of the knowledge base owner
Owner.description_zh: 知识库负责人的 DataWorks 用户 ID

Status.description_en: The public status of the knowledge base. This list returns only normally visible knowledge bases, and the value is ACTIVE
Status.description_zh: 知识库公共状态。本列表仅返回正常可见知识库，值为 ACTIVE

Type.description_en:
The type of the knowledge base. Valid values:
PERSONAL: personal knowledge base
ENTERPRISE: enterprise knowledge base
Type.description_zh: 知识库类型：PERSONAL 为个人知识库，ENTERPRISE 为企业知识库

NextToken.description_en: The pagination cursor. Do not specify this parameter when you request the first page. For subsequent pages, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response as is. An empty response indicates that no more pages are available. If the current page is empty but the cursor is not empty, continue pagination. Keep the same MaxResults value during pagination
NextToken.description_zh: 分页游标。请求第一页时不传；后续页原样使用上次响应的 NextToken。响应为空表示没有下一页；即使当前页为空，游标非空仍应继续。翻页时保持相同 MaxResults

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of knowledge bases to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
MaxResults.description_zh: 每页最多返回的知识库数量，取值 1～100

Message.description_en: A human-readable description of the business error. This field may be omitted if the request succeeds. Provide the RequestId when troubleshooting failures
Message.description_zh: 业务错误的可读说明，成功时可省略。失败定位时请同时提供 RequestId

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
